items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: The Savoy thing you're taking about, right?

ctx.x: And then I'm always coming back to that date which I think is one of the great unsung dates, with Brew Moore and J.J. Johnson, because there you're playing very harmonically, intricate, very beautiful things...
Yeah. Well, I've got that album here, where I was playing with... The Savoy thing you're taking about, right?
No, now I'm talking about that Blue Note date that we talked about before...
